svg.title: Lesson 19: pole and zero locations beside calculated unit-step responses

ns2:Work.dc:title: Lesson 19: pole and zero locations beside calculated unit-step responses
ns2:Work.dc:description: Analytical predictions from the four supplied lesson models; not measured simulation data. Settling y=1-exp(-t/25); accumulating y=0.1t; oscillating y=1-exp(-0.3t)(cos(bt)+0.3/b sin(bt)), b=sqrt(2.16); inverse y=2(1-exp(-t/20))-(1-exp(-t/2)).

g.text: A zero to the right of the origin is not a growing pole. In row 4, both poles are negative and both underlying responses settle.
